ovicidal.m: Having the ability to kill an ovum.

ovicide.m: Any substance designed to kill or destroy eggs or ova, especially those of insects, mites, or other pests or parasites.

ovicides.m: More than one ovicide. ovicide: any substance designed to kill or destroy eggs or ova, especially those of insects, mites, or other pests or parasites.

oviductal.m: Of, pertaining to, or occurring in the oviduct.

ovines.m: More than one ovine. ovine: of or pertaining to or of the nature of or characteristic of a sheep or sheep.

ovipositional.m: Related to, or by means of, oviposition.

ovisacs.m: More than one ovisac. ovisac: a Graafian follicle.
